nodes.title: SG-11.2 BootScene listens for transitionTo and fades to the requested scene
nodes.body:
Context: events.ts already declares ReactToPhaserEvents.transitionTo { sceneId } and BootScene already listens for playAnimation, but nothing consumes transitionTo. Desired behavior: BootScene.create subscribes to transitionTo, runs a camera fade-out and then starts the requested scene, and releases the subscription in its SHUTDOWN handler. Expected result: React can drive scene changes through the typed bus. Why: SG-11 drives animations and transitions from game actions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create ran, when transitionTo { sceneId } is emitted, then the main camera fades out
- Given the fade-out completes, when FADE_OUT_COMPLETE fires, then scene.start is called with the requested sceneId
- Given the SHUTDOWN callback ran, when transitionTo is emitted, then no fade or scene start occurs


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene transitionTo subscription
- In scope: fade then scene start
- In scope: unsubscribe on SHUTDOWN
- Out of scope: Emitting transitionTo from App
- Out of scope: new scenes or content
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Preserve: playAnimation handling
- Preserve: existing sceneReady and effect behavior
- Preserve: event bus API


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Use the existing reactToPhaser bus from frontend/src/phaser/events.ts


## Definition of done
- Both requirements have Act and Verify units complete
- Unit tests pass with Phaser mocked


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene fades to the requested scene on transitionTo
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create subscribes to playAnimation only. Desired behavior: subscribe to transitionTo and run a fade transition to the requested scene. Expected result: emitting transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } fades out then starts 'library'. Why: lets React change scenes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create ran, when transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } is emitted, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called once
- Given the fade-out completed, when FADE_OUT_COMPLETE fires, then scene.start is called with 'library'


## Scope
- In scope: transitionTo subscription
- In scope: fade-out then scene.start
- Out of scope: App emitting the event
- Preserve: playAnimation subscription


## Technical constraints
- Fade duration is the scene's transition effect durationMs, defaulting to 400


## Definition of done
- Subscription stored in a field for cleanup
- Scene start only after FADE_OUT_COMPLETE


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene unsubscribes transitionTo when the scene shuts down
nodes.body:
Context: the SHUTDOWN handler already releases the playAnimation subscription. Desired behavior: also release transitionTo so a dead scene does not react. Expected result: after shutdown, transitionTo emits do nothing.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the SHUTDOWN callback ran, when transitionTo is emitted, then fadeOut is not called
- Given another transitionTo subscriber registered before create, when shutdown ran, then it still receives events


## Scope
- In scope: unsubscribe in SHUTDOWN handler
- Out of scope: other subscriptions
- Preserve: existing shutdown cleanup


## Technical constraints
- Call only the unsubscribe function returned by reactToPhaser.on, never clear()


## Definition of done
- Unsubscribe field reset to null


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Subscribe BootScene to transitionTo with fade-out and scene start
nodes.body:
In BootScene.ts add a private unsubscribeTransition field, subscribe in create after the playAnimation subscription, and add a handler that fades out then starts the scene.

## Acceptance criteria
- transitionTo emit calls cameras.main.fadeOut
- FADE_OUT_COMPLETE calls scene.start with the sceneId

- Out of scope: tests
- Out of scope: App
- Preserve: playAnimation

- Code path: `game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts`

- Type-check passes

nodes.summary: Add transitionTo subscription and handler in BootScene
nodes.description: In BootScene.ts add a private unsubscribeTransition field, subscribe in create after the playAnimation subscription, and add a handler that fades out then starts the scene.
acceptance_criteria: FADE_OUT_COMPLETE calls scene.start with the sceneId

steps.action: Add a private field unsubscribeTransition typed (() => void) | null initialised to null, next to unsubscribeAnimation.

Add private method transitionToScene(sceneId: string) that reads the durationMs of the first scene.effects entry with type 'transition' (default 400), calls this.cameras.main.fadeOut(durationMs), and registers this.cameras.main.once(Phaser.Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE, () => this.scene.start(sceneId)).
steps.expected: Method compiles and is the only place that fades out.

steps.action: Subscribe to the transitionTo event and store the returned unsubscribe in this.unsubscribeTransition.
